summary: Frontend testing of POS Modal (نقطة البيع) Liquid redesign with mobile support. All requested features working correctly: Liquid design, fullscreen mobile dialog (100vw/100dvh), tabs navigation, step buttons (Next/Prev), transaction types, and touch-friendly inputs.

issues: Pre-existing horizontal overflow (70px) on the Parts Inventory page itself - not related to POS modal update. The modal correctly has overflow-x:hidden but the underlying page content is wider than mobile viewport.
design_issues.note: This is a pre-existing issue, not introduced by the Liquid POS update

context_for_next_testing_agent: POS Modal (PartsTransactionModal.jsx) Liquid redesign fully tested. All features working: fullscreen mobile (390x844), Liquid glass design, 3 tabs (العملية/الربط/السلة), Next/Prev step navigation, transaction types (sale/purchase/direct), touch targets (46px+ height). Minor pre-existing issue: PartsInventory page has 70px horizontal overflow on mobile - not related to this update.
verified_features: POS button opens modal from /parts page
Modal title 'نقطة البيع والعمليات المباشرة' displays correctly
Liquid design applied (.liquid-pos class with glass/gradient styling)
Three tabs visible: 1) العملية, 2) الربط, 3) السلة
Tab navigation via clicking tabs works
Next button (التالي) navigates to next tab
Prev button (السابق) navigates to previous tab
Sale mode dropdown appears for sale type only
Direct operation shows amount and description inputs
Add item button (+ إضافة قطعة أخرى) adds new item row
Remove item button (حذف البند) removes item row
Submit button text changes based on transaction type
Modal has overflow-x: hidden (no horizontal scroll in modal)
notes: The horizontal overflow detected during testing is from the PartsInventory page content behind the modal, not from the modal itself. The modal correctly implements overflow-x:hidden and is fullscreen on mobile. This is a pre-existing page layout issue, not introduced by the Liquid POS update.
